title: Worker Dashboard
summary: Field workforce roster and assignment lifecycle, with nearest-worker dispatch and per-worker sequenced job queues.

provenance.notes: Retains FieldOps conventions (/v1 base path, Bearer auth, snake_case, flat { error, detail } envelope). Vocabulary is deliberately domain-neutral — 'job_ref', not 'bin_id' — because FieldOps sells the same product into other verticals. Keeping that generality preserves resale value beyond waste collection.

trade.notes: Highest-value module in the registry: the only one with an escrowed source agreement and the only one whose vocabulary is vertical-agnostic. Carries three outbound dependencies, all optional and degrading.

interface.conventions: snake_case payloads; flat error envelope { error, detail }

requires.degradation: Queue returns stops unordered with optimized:false and a degraded_reason; the worker still sees their jobs.
Assignment and completion still succeed; the alert is skipped and reported in side_effects.
